product_metadata.title: FMFUNCTEX Damask Print Curtains 95" Long on Premium White Curtains for Living Room Classic Floral Bedroom Window Draperies 1 Pair Natural, Grommet Top
features: 【Ready Made】These white and natural damask print curtains are sold in pairs, measuring 50" W x 95" L/Panel; 100"W x 95" L/Pair
【Elaborate floral Design】Featuring an overall printing damask pattern on white curtains, canvas textured fabric diffuses light evenly and brighten up your place

【Elegant & Light Filtering】Elegant vintage print curtains complete your room, with light coming through in a soft glow! No need to combine this with heavier blackout curtains or blinds to achieve more privacy while enhance a harmonious atmosphere.

【Grommet Top Curtains】All our fabrications are formaldehyde free, tested by third party labs and functional as well. 8 sliver gery grommets on each panel fit well with most standard or decorative curtain rods. Panels are well made with sophistication and neatly packaged. Machine washable, quick iron or steam clean if needed.
【Care Instructions】 Machine washable, gentle cycle, do not bleach, quick iron or steam clean if needed. Pick our premium window panel pair for elegant decoration immediately!
